title: A Devil and Her Love Song
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Maria Kawai transfers to a new high school after being expelled from a Catholic girls' school for striking a nun. Her blunt honesty makes her an outcast nicknamed 'Devil Maria', but her singing draws two classmates, cheerful Yusuke and aloof Shin, into her life. Maria faces class bullying, a homeroom teacher who scapegoats her, and memories of a lost friendship as she leads the class choir.
life_message: Honesty and a true voice, joined with real friendship, can break through cruelty and isolation.
